tools_used: CourtListener MCP citation search and opinion snippet search
Web search for a historical precedent
Direct web retrieval of the snapshot-linked reply brief
helpful: Frozen salience version, band and distribution count made the correct base-rate population explicit.
A readable BIO exposed concrete vehicle objections that were absent from the petition's framing.
The exact reply URL in the snapshot allowed retrieval of pre-decision advocacy without searching current case history.
CourtListener snippet retrieval checked both sides of the key precedent efficiently.
gaps: The petition source is truncated, leaving an incomplete appendix.
Provisioning the filed cert reply would avoid an extra external retrieval.
A displayed pack build timestamp and case last-pulled stamp would clarify freshness.
Distribution count alone does not distinguish a response-driven redistribution from substantive relisting.
notes: The default uv cache path was read-only; redirecting the cache under /tmp restored the CLI. No live corpus query was needed. No outcome retrieval or degraded CourtListener access occurred.
